actual_operation: Each timed operation reads the same initial state, performs one or four updates with fresh output/state allocations, and torch.cat of outputs. It does not clone initial_state inside the measured operation. run_case clones the initial result state after the first timing only.
interpretation: Timing includes Python dispatch, allocator operations, output concatenation and CUDA synchronization on a shared GPU. No isolated kernel latency or full-model speedup is established.
effect_on_numerical_checks: None; initial input state immutability was separately tested in both cases.
